description: The file contains unit tests for various functions related to LINE group key resolution and configuration, using the 'vitest' testing framework.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupLookupIds
methods.description: Expands a raw group or room ID into an array including prefixed versions.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupConfigEntry
methods.description: Resolves configuration entries for a given line group ID, supporting raw, prefixed, and wildcard entries.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupHistoryKey
methods.description: Determines the LINE peer key (group or room ID) for chat history purposes.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupsConfig
methods.description: Resolves the effective configuration for line groups considering account-specific overrides.

methods.name: resolveExactLineGroupConfigKey
methods.description: Resolves a specific line group configuration key based on account and group ID.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupRequireMention
methods.description: Determines if a line group requires a mention for messaging based on configuration.
